title: Looks Like a Wall
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about walls that aren't what they look like. A real wall and a picture of a wall can be drawn exactly alike, and only one stops Mia. A touch can turn a block into a second block, and that one into a third, so a wall cracks and then crumbles. A fair secret gets a hint: coins showing in a wall. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a block's setting.

box.back: A small explorer in a purple beanie has three short levels, and brick walls in the way each time. One wall is real and stops them. The next is only a picture of a wall, and they walk through it. A wall can crack when it is touched, and crumble when it is touched again, and a few coins showing in a wall hint at a secret. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a block's setting.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Solid is a setting of the block, not part of its picture
A touch can turn a block into another, and that one into a third
Made to be copied and taken apart
